title: Banking Data Engineering Cortex Code Lab
scenario: Build a repeatable, reviewed customer net-spend transformation over synthetic retail-banking card and account transactions.
outcome: Participants leave able to repeat one real workflow on their own data, with a clear next step
expected_text: LOCATIONS 5 rows, CUSTOMERS 100 rows, TRANSACTIONS 1200 rows; NET_SPEND 339300.29.
interface_notes:
- Open a Workspace, then Cortex Code in the lower-right corner. Use Plan mode before multi-step work.
- Personal skills live in `.snowflake/cortex/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` in that workspace (+ Create Skill, then paste the starter from the lab step page).
- Plugins, local hooks and custom subagent files are shown by the facilitator from Desktop/CLI.
- **Trial accounts:** each participant runs `admin/setup.sql` in their own trial as the account owner before the lab, then switches to the participant role.
